Fixed the release notes script so it no longer silently aborts when given an empty version range.

versions.title: Release 2026.04.25 (build 6)
summary: Added a light/dark/system appearance toggle and refreshed the macOS toolbar/board chrome for a more native look.
Improved section navigation and window titling: section labels now appear in the toolbar, with better jump-button visibility and off-screen section access.
Standardized floating pills and source/task controls, including consistent sizing, clearer labels, and better placement around the board.
Updated the board layout and visuals: refined lane spacing/alignment, softer lane tints, tinted glass lane containers, and new background image assets.
Fixed search and focus behavior, including more stable toolbar actions, no unwanted refocus after exiting search, and fewer async warnings.
Improved release/test automation: fixed single-worker test execution, removed a problematic parallel-testing setting, and added release checks/Discord notification requirements.
Added usability improvements for source links and Linear integration, including opening tickets in the Linear desktop app and always showing source links.
